meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides Target's Ask AI button, rating badges and promo heroes; blur/hide product pictures and prices
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, real Chrome (headless) on www.target.com (home) with iPhone UA 390x844 and desktop UA, DOM captured after 7 seconds. Fixtures `real.html` and `desktop-real.html` are sanitised excerpts (text and product ids stripped, needed ancestors only, `data-keep` on the main container and the account link).

LIVE: `[aria-label="Ask Target"]` 2 on the phone page (0 on the desktop capture; the aria label is English-only), `[data-test="product-tile-desirability-cue-badge"]` 96, `[data-test$="SlingshotComponents/Superhero"]` 5, `[data-test$="SlingshotComponents/Storyblocks"]` 2, `[data-test="carousel-tile-image"]` 96, `[data-test$="Price/PriceAndPromoMinimal"]` 96, `[data-test$="SlingshotComponents/ProductsCarousel"]` 4. The original ad rule matched Google ad iframes (see playbook); cookie and app-banner rules matched nothing.

Choices: Product pictures and Prices and promos each Show/Blur/Hide. Target's `data-test` attributes are stable test hooks; its CSS-module classes (`styles_x__Hash`) are hashed and not used.

NOT verified: search results, product and category pages, the cart, logged-in home. The "Sponsored" tiles carry only a label (`data-test="sponsored-text"`) and no wrapper hook was found, so sponsored tiles are not hidden.
